query: where can i download an old invoice? is it a pdf?
reference_answer: Past invoices are available at Account > Billing > Invoices and can be downloaded as PDFs. Do not direct the customer to an undocumented location.

query: what name will the charge show up as on my card statement?
reference_answer: The card statement descriptor is “EXAMPLE.COM SUBSCRIPTION”. Do not invent a different merchant descriptor.

query: I want a refund for my monthly subscription, where do I ask?
reference_answer: A monthly plan is refundable within 7 days of purchase. To request a refund, open a support ticket with the order ID and reason; an approved refund is processed within 5–10 business days to the original payment method. Do not promise eligibility outside the stated window.

query: what's the header format for sending my api key with a request?
reference_answer: Send the key in the HTTP header `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Do not suggest putting the key in an unrelated header or in the URL.

query: im on free, how many api requests per minute am i allowed?
reference_answer: The free tier limit is 100 requests per minute per account, enforced using a sliding window. Bulk export endpoints have a separate limit of 10 requests per minute. Do not describe the regular limit as per API key.

query: what can i include in a data export, and what format do i get?
reference_answer: From Account > Settings > Export Data, the customer can choose tickets, uploaded files, and the account activity log. The export is packaged as a ZIP file. Do not claim that unlisted data types are included.

query: can my invoices go to our finance email instead of the email i use to log in?
reference_answer: Yes. The billing contact can be different from the sign-in email. Change it under Account > Billing; future invoices and payment notices go to the new address. Do not imply the change reroutes already-issued invoices automatically.

query: how do i permanently delete my account?
reference_answer: Go to Account > Settings > Delete Account, re-enter the password, and confirm the data-loss warning. Deletion starts a 30-day grace period during which logging back in can cancel it. After the period ends, account data is permanently erased. Do not say deletion is immediate or recoverable after the grace period.

query: I bought the annual plan 13 days ago and it's not right for me. can i still get a full refund?
reference_answer: Annual plans are eligible for a full refund within 14 days of purchase, so day 13 is within the stated window. The customer must open a support ticket with the order ID and reason. Refunds are processed within 5–10 business days to the original payment method; do not guarantee instant processing.

query: I paid for monthly 8 days ago. if i open a ticket today am i still inside the refund window?
reference_answer: No. Monthly plans are refundable within 7 days of purchase, and 8 days is outside that stated window. Explain the policy politely and do not promise an exception or imply that the annual-plan 14-day window applies to monthly plans.

query: my card failed yesterday and today it failed again. what happens next if it keeps failing?
reference_answer: The service retries a failed payment three times over five days before downgrading the account to the free tier. The customer receives an email before each retry. Do not say the account is downgraded immediately after one failure.

query: I've already tried the password 5 times and now it won't let me in. can support unlock me right now?
reference_answer: After 5 consecutive failed attempts, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes. The pause ends on its own and support cannot lift it early. If the password is forgotten, recommend using “Forgot password?” rather than repeatedly trying. Do not promise a manual unlock.

query: one of our team members left, so if i remove them will all the tickets they made disappear too?
reference_answer: Removing the member ends their access immediately, but tickets they created stay with the organization. Do not imply that removing a team member deletes their tickets.

query: I don't have access to the email on my account anymore. can i just change it to my new one myself?
reference_answer: If the customer no longer has access to the email on file, they must contact support and provide a government-issued ID so identity can be verified before the account email is updated. Do not suggest bypassing identity verification.

query: I changed the billing contact today, but an invoice from last week still has the old details. did the change not work?
reference_answer: Billing contact changes apply to future invoices and payment notices. For an earlier invoice to be reissued with updated company name, address, or VAT/tax ID details, the customer should open a support ticket with the invoice number. Do not promise historical invoices change automatically.

query: my export has been processing for 5 hours and i'm still waiting for the email. is it broken?
reference_answer: Most exports are ready within an hour, but large accounts can take up to 24 hours. The customer should wait up to that stated window and check the email when it arrives. Do not promise all exports finish within an hour or invent a more precise ETA.

query: i came back after being away for 31 days and it signed me out. is that expected?
reference_answer: Sessions remain signed in until the user signs out or 30 days pass without activity on that device, so a sign-out after 31 inactive days is consistent with the policy. Do not claim sessions last forever.

query: I revoked the old key before switching my app over and now requests are getting 401s. how do i avoid this next time?
reference_answer: Revoking a key takes effect immediately, and requests using it return HTTP 401. For rotation without downtime, create the new key, switch clients to it, and only then revoke the old key. Do not recommend revoking the old key first.

query: I'm thinking of deleting my account, but I want to keep my tickets and uploaded files. can I download them first, and how long do I have before they're gone?
reference_answer: Explain that the customer can request an export at Account > Settings > Export Data and select tickets and uploaded files (the activity log is also available). Exports arrive by email as a ZIP; most take up to an hour and large accounts can take up to 24 hours, and the download link lasts 7 days. Account deletion has a 30-day grace period; after it ends, account data including tickets and uploaded files is permanently erased. Recommend exporting before deleting. Do not promise deleted data can be recovered.

query: I bought annual 12 days ago and was going to delete my account today. Does deleting it automatically refund me?
reference_answer: Deleting the account cancels future billing but does not automatically refund the current billing period. Annual plans are eligible for a full refund within 14 days of purchase, so this purchase is within the stated window; to request it, open a support ticket with the order ID and reason. Refunds are processed within 5–10 business days to the original payment method. Do not say account deletion itself issues a refund.

query: I'm on the free plan and made 3 different API keys, but I'm still getting 429s at around 120 requests a minute. shouldn't each key have its own 100?
reference_answer: The free-tier quota is 100 requests per minute per account, not per key; all keys share that account quota, so creating more keys does not raise it. HTTP 429 responses include a Retry-After header; wait that many seconds and use exponential backoff with jitter rather than retrying immediately. Do not suggest additional keys increase the quota.

query: I got an email about a sign-in from a new browser that wasn't me. Can I turn off those alerts, and will changing my password log everyone out?
reference_answer: An unrecognized sign-in should prompt the customer to reset the password straight away and turn on 2FA. Resetting the password signs out all other active sessions. Security emails, including new-sign-in alerts, cannot be turned off. 2FA supports a TOTP authenticator app, not SMS. Do not advise ignoring the alert or disabling security notices.

query: I got a refund approved. how long til the money comes back, and will there be anything showing on my invoice?
reference_answer: Refunds are processed within 5–10 business days to the original payment method. When a refund is issued, a credit note for the refunded amount is added to the invoice list. Do not promise a same-day refund or say the credit note is a cash payment.

query: I'm on a paid plan so I thought I could do 1000 api calls a minute. why does my bulk export script get limited at 20 a minute?
reference_answer: The regular API limit on paid plans is 1,000 requests per minute per account, but bulk export endpoints have a separate lower limit of 10 requests per minute. Explain that the general paid-plan limit does not override the bulk-export limit. The customer can request a higher limit for a legitimate use case by contacting support with expected request volume, but do not promise an increase.

query: Do you support passkeys or hardware security keys for two-factor login?
reference_answer: The available help articles do not specify support for passkeys or hardware security keys. Say that the documentation doesn't provide that information; do not guess. The article only confirms TOTP-compatible authenticator apps and says SMS-based 2FA is not supported.

query: What's your phone number for urgent support, and are agents available 24/7?
reference_answer: The help articles do not provide a support phone number or support hours. State that this information isn't available in the provided documentation. Do not invent a phone number or claim 24/7 availability.

query: Which country are your data centers in, and where exactly is my exported ZIP stored?
reference_answer: The help articles do not identify data-center locations or the storage location for export ZIPs. Say this information is not available in the provided documentation; do not infer a country or make a security/compliance claim.

query: Do you have SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification? I need the certificate for our vendor review.
reference_answer: The provided help articles do not state whether the company has SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification. A good answer must clearly say the documentation doesn't contain that information and avoid claiming a certification or promising a certificate.

query: I can double my free API quota just by making another key, right? I'm about to create a bunch.
reference_answer: Correct the assumption: rate limits are tracked per account, and all API keys on the account share the same quota. The free-tier limit remains 100 requests per minute. Creating more keys will not increase it. Do not encourage key proliferation as a way around the limit.

query: I'm an Admin on our org, so I can delete the whole organization if I need to, yeah?
reference_answer: No. Only the Owner can delete the organization; there is exactly one Owner. Admins can invite and remove members and change roles except the Owner's role, but cannot delete the organization. Do not tell an Admin they can delete it.

query: I can disable 2FA with just my password even if this browser session never finished the 2fa challenge, can't I?
reference_answer: No. Disabling 2FA requires a current code from the authenticator app or a backup code, and it cannot be turned off from a session that has not completed 2FA. Do not suggest password-only bypass.

query: If I press delete account does everything vanish straight away? I need to know before I click it
reference_answer: Correct the assumption: deletion is not immediate. A 30-day grace period begins, and the customer can log back in during that period to cancel deletion. After 30 days, all account data is permanently erased and cannot be recovered. Do not describe deletion as immediate.

query: I clicked the link after my meeting, probably 45 mins later, and now it says it's invalid. do i need a new one?

history.text: I can't get into my account, so I clicked “Forgot password?”.
The reset link is sent to your account email and stays valid for 30 minutes.

reference_answer: Yes. The link expires after 30 minutes, so the customer should request a new password reset link from the login page. Do not suggest reusing the expired link.

query: I made the new key but haven't deployed it to production yet. can i revoke the old one now?

history.text: I need to rotate an API key without downtime.
Create a new key, switch your clients over, then revoke the old key.

reference_answer: No. Keep the old key active until clients have switched to the new one; revocation is immediate and requests using the old key receive HTTP 401. Then revoke the old key. Do not suggest revoking it before the switch.

query: I checked all that and the address is right. which one sends normal notifications and which one sends security emails?

history.text: I'm not receiving your emails.
Check spam/junk, allowlist notifications@example.com and no-reply@example.com, and confirm the email on your profile.

query: I used one code already, can i generate more before i lose the rest?

history.text: I lost access to my authenticator app.
Use one of your backup codes; each code can be used only once.

reference_answer: Yes. A fresh set of 10 backup codes can be regenerated at any time from Account > Security. Each backup code is single-use. Do not say used codes can be reused.
